verdict.rationale: Vercel plugs into existing Git hosts (GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket) with deploy-on-push and per-branch previews, and supports Next.js plus 40+ other frameworks. Its open-source CLI is documented for use in automated systems with scoped tokens, which covers running it from existing CI. One community comment notes the platform's language support is limited to JS/TS/Go, which narrows how far you can bring your own stack. Missing for 10: explicit docs for third-party CI providers (e.g. GitHub Actions), editor-workflow evidence beyond AI coding-tool plugins, and independent hands-on corroboration that no proprietary tooling is required.
